capabilities: Archive notes and folders into .textpack zip files
Browse, search and edit archive contents in a dedicated view
Restore archives back into the vault
Generate index files for Obsidian and Omnisearch
extras: No telemetry, account or payment; interface in English and German. Dataview, Meta Bind and other plugins that read Obsidian's index of real files do not work inside archives.
motivation: Old trips, finished projects or meeting notes clutter the vault, the graph and every search, but the author did not want to delete them.
problem: Archived notes and finished projects clutter the vault, graph and search, but Obsidian cannot open or search content inside zip files.

relations.evidence: Obsidian and Omnisearch can't look into zip files. With Create index file enabled
archives stay readable by other apps (Bear, iA Writer, Ulysses, …)

summary: Packs notes and folders into searchable .textpack archives with a dedicated viewer, search and editor, and converts to and from .textbundle folders.
